title: PR 181 gestures: keyboard recall on tap uses a new required NoteTouchSelection.onRequestKeyboard
context: Review finding on PR 181 (branch mitosis/gestures): tapping the caret or a selection only toggled the toolbar, so on Android the soft keyboard never came back after Back (spec I1). The editor assembly shows the keyboard only from _changeSelection for tap causes.
options: route the toggle branch through onSelectionChanged(current, tap)
outcome: Required VoidCallback onRequestKeyboard, called on every single tap-up except checkbox toggles (commit eca798d). Sending the event through onSelectionChanged would make the assembly's spelling toolbar reopen after a tap on a misspelled caret, so the tap could no longer toggle that toolbar. An optional callback would do nothing unnoticed until wired. Required matches the widget's other callbacks, and the compiler forces every host to wire it.
